changelog: 🌐 Phase 18 Upgrade: Native HTTP / SOCKS5 Proxy & Network Traffic Inspector in Rust.
⚡ Real-Time Throughput & Bandwidth Meter: Rolling download and upload throughput calculation, active socket tracking, and error monitoring.
🛡️ Traffic Inspector: Zero-overhead circular ring-buffer recording HTTP transactions, status codes, latency, and request/response payloads.
🔌 Upstream Connectivity Testing: High-precision async TCP handshake and proxy latency diagnostics.
